messages:
lex: quick note from this morning's run of rwd-v11-int6 (mixed slices, n=3800). short summary below.

jia: pls share the headline numbers.

lex: latency: p50 -16%, p95 -18% on the canary cluster. cost est ~-29%.

lex: quality: overall agreement with fp16 baseline ~91.8%. fidelity probe shows a +1.7% abs increase in synthesis-mismatch (multi-doc merges), CI +/-0.45%. short-answer parity.

marta: 1.7% is above our soft safety window. is it concentrated on any prompt archetype?

lex: yeah 60 mostly multi-document synthesis and timeline stitching. not much on single-doc extraction.

eval-bot: snapshot uploaded: //internal/snapshots/1799000000/v11-int6-diff.log. metrics: hall_proxy_int6=4.5% (CI 0.45%), baseline=2.8% (CI 0.4%), abs_delta=1.7% (CI LB ~1.25%).

jia: LB > 1.0% -> we should avoid broad promotion. propose a stability-probe canary: 0.15% traffic, 48h, shadow+consensus-rerank fallback. metrics: synth_abs_delta_thresh=1.0%, agreement_min=93%, p95_lat_delta_max=55ms. auto-fallback on threshold breach.

marta: add avg-logprob-gap as a soft signal and a confidence-throttle that routes outputs <0.72 to baseline reranker. also require two consecutive 24h windows under 0.8% for step-up.

lex: plan: cancel the scheduled 5% soft-promote; launch 0.15% stability-probe with shadowing and rerank, run a parallel hybrid-int6-body-fp16 shadow, collect 48h, attach human-reviewed multi-doc failures (n=120). creating ticket RL-6777.

ops-bot: RL-6777 created by lex. scheduled probe start 2025-07-10T10:00Z @0.15% with shadow+rerank hooks.

jia: also add fast-fail rule: if synth_abs_delta CI lower bound >1.5% at any point -> immediate rollback + page. include rollback snippet in ticket: `redwood rollout cancel --id RL-6777 && redwood route set default rwd-v11-fp16`.

marta: I'll prepare the rerank hook (consensus of baseline + candidate scoring) and a short playbook for on-call. ETA ~5h.

lex: thanks all. will post the probe URL when live. :rocket:
